name: treg
description: Optional hosted social-media collection through treg (treg.to), a pay-per-call registry of data providers: public posts, search, replies and followers on X, and profile posts on Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and LinkedIn, each through one pinned provider endpoint. Activated only when TREG_API_KEY is set; the Engine injects it when treg is enabled in Indicator Labs, from-repo users export it themselves.
use_when: A bounded set of public posts is needed from an X, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook or LinkedIn profile, an X or LinkedIn keyword search, or the replies or followers of an X post or account, and no native platform API path fits. One request, no actor run to wait for.
rate_limit_note: Each call is billed from the member's own prepaid treg balance (fractions of a cent per page; the helper prints the settled cost) and fails when the balance is empty. The helper caps every call with a cost ceiling. Platform ToS caveat: X prohibits scraping even public posts, so collection on X through any provider is a ToS-violating path; record the collection authority in access_notes and prefer the official API or a licensed broker where legal scrutiny is likely.
